name: What kind of paint is best for a new home addition?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for a new home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best paint for a new home addition depends on the specific area and its use. For interior walls and ceilings, durable latex paints with a low VOC (volatile organic compound) are often recommended for their ease of application, quick drying time, and reduced odor. For high-traffic areas like kitchens or bathrooms, a semi-gloss or satin finish provides better durability and moisture resistance. Exterior additions require weather-resistant exterior paints designed to withstand the elements.
acceptedAnswer.description: The best paint depends on the area; latex for interior walls, semi-gloss/satin for high-traffic areas, and weather-resistant paint for exteriors.
